name: bloodlink
description: Find nearby blood donors in minutes. React + Node.js + MongoDB + Socket.io.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c red,blue "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:phone: concurrently -n server,client -c red,blue "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev:phone --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
